display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Flight Disruption Detected
(Authoritative Carrier Webhook / Aviation Radar Ingress)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
WhatsApp Interactive Notification
[ RESCUE MY TRIP ] | [ ABANDON RESCUE ]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PASSENGER_DECLINED
Close Rescue Case
Preserve Original Ticket (No Auto-Refund)
Alert Agency Operations Desk

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Validate Passenger Ownership
Transition to FETCHING_ITINERARY
Immediate Acknowledgment Dispatched
Fetch Complete PNR & All Itinerary Segments
Analyze Downstream Connection & Hotel Risks

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Transition to SEARCHING_ALTERNATIVES
Search Candidate Flights on Carrier Network
Calculate Published MCT & Flyo Safety Buffer
Deterministic Multi-Factor Option Ranking

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
NO_OPTIONS_AVAILABLE → ESCALATED
Hand over to Human Travel Desk Specialist

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Transition to OPTIONS_READY → AWAITING_OPTION_SELECTION
Send Ranked Options on WhatsApp
• Option 1: FL101 (Direct) +₹0 (Recommended)
• Option 2: FL301 (1 Stop) +₹4,200
• Option 3: FL401 (Direct) +₹1,500

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Passenger Selects Flight Option
(e.g., SELECT_OPTION_O1 or SELECT_OPTION_O2)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
OPTION_SELECTED → REVALIDATING_OPTION
Revalidate Live Carrier Seat Availability & Fare Rules
Recalculate Downstream Connection Feasibility

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
OPTION_EXPIRED → REFRESHING_ALTERNATIVES
Closed-Loop Inventory Refresh & Return to Search

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
FARE_CHANGED → Display Updated Cost
Invalidate Previous Consent & Require Fresh OTP

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
AWAITING_PASSENGER_CONFIRMATION → AWAITING_PASSENGER_OTP
Present Final Itinerary Preview & Exact Cost
Generate Single-Use 6-Digit Confirmation OTP
(Bound to Case + Phone + Option + Fare + Currency, 10m Expiry)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
AWAITING_PASSENGER_OTP
Passenger Enters 6-Digit Consent Code in WhatsApp

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
OTP_FAILED → AWAITING_PASSENGER_OTP
Decrement Attempt Counter & Prompt Retry

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
OTP_EXPIRED → AWAITING_PASSENGER_OTP
Regenerate Fresh Challenge & Prompt Retry

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
LOCKED_OUT → ESCALATED
30-Minute Security Lockout
Alert Agency Operations Desk

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PASSENGER_VERIFIED
Passenger Consent Authoritatively Locked
Invalidate Challenge to Prevent Replay

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PATH A: NO PAYMENT REQUIRED
• Skip VCC Issuance Entirely
• Skip Payment Gateway Processing
• Apply Agency Booking Authorization Policy
• Transition: PASSENGER_VERIFIED → REBOOKING

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PATH B: PAYMENT REQUIRED
Transition: PASSENGER_VERIFIED → VERIFYING_AGENCY_APPROVAL
Check Corporate Policy & Agency Spending Limits (e.g. ₹50k / ₹100k)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
AGENCY_APPROVAL_REQUIRED → MANUAL_APPROVAL_PENDING
Agency Policy Exception Review (Not a Payment Failure)
Await Operator Budget Approval in Console

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT_READY
Issue Single-Use Corporate Virtual Card (VCC)
Locked to Case, Option, Approved Fare & MCC 3000

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
REBOOKING
Dispatch Rebooking Subprocess with VCC Credentials

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
AUTHORIZED REBOOKING
Airline NDC API / Playwright Partner Portal Engine

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
VERIFYING_BOOKING
Independently Verify Reservation on Airline Host System

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
VERIFYING_TICKET
Confirm Electronic Ticket (e-Ticket) Issuance & Coupon Validation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PAYMENT_AUTH_PENDING → PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED → PAYMENT_CAPTURED
Record Settlement & Capture with Card Issuer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
DONE (RESCUED)
Update Core Booking Record to 'Rescued'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
FINAL WHATSAPP CONFIRMATION
Verified Itinerary + Confirmed Airline PNR
e-Ticket Status (ISSUED & VALIDATED)
Secure Itinerary Link + Baggage Transfer Guidance
(Boarding Pass Opens at Carrier Check-In 24h Prior)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Definitive Booking Failure
(e.g., Confirmed Sold Out / Carrier Rejection)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PAYMENT_VOIDED / PAYMENT_REFUNDED
Void Uncaptured VCC Authorization or Refund Captured Payment

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
BOOKING_FAILED → ESCALATED
Alert Operations Console & Notify Passenger

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED → RECONCILING
Query Carrier Host using Idempotency Key (caseId)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PAYMENT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → FAILED_ESCALATED
Retain Recoverable Case (No Blind Retries)
Alert Agency Operations Desk for Manual Resolution
